title: 1623 Prairie's oriel rises through the roof to its spire
items: Granger Farwell's oriel now climbs past the main cornice as its 1886 drawing shows: a carved frieze, an upper stage of shorter windows and a steep slate spire with a finial.
The house's eave, gutter and cornice moulding stop against the oriel's sides instead of running through it.
Heights were read through the drawing's camera; the frieze's carving is a reconstruction, recorded as a liberty.
